espn.short: Aubrey went 2-for-3 on field-goal attempts and made all three of his PATs during Sunday's 27-23 win over the Colts.
espn.long: Aubrey was able to convert multiple field-goal tries for the third straight game, but he did miss a kick for the second straight week. The kicker had makes from 45 and 28 yards in the contest, but he continued his long-range struggles Sunday, pulling a 50-yard attempt wide left late in the fourth quarter. Aubrey has now gone 17-for-22 on field-goal tries, including 3-for-8 from 50-plus yards, over nine contests to open the 2026 campaign.

sections.Intro: The longest successful regular season field goal in National Football League (NFL) history is 68 yards by Cam Little of the Jacksonville Jaguars against the Las Vegas Raiders on November 2, 2025. The longest field goal attempt in an NFL game was 76 yards by Sebastian Janikowski of the Oakland Raiders against the San Diego Chargers on September 28, 2008. The longest successful field goal in NFL playoff history is 58 yards, first accomplished by Pete Stoyanovich on January 5, 1991, and then matched by Graham Gano on January 7, 2018. The Super Bowl record is 57 yards, set by Harrison Butker in Super Bowl LVIII.
